test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_daily_paper_cycle.py tests/test_daily_evidence_bundle.py tests/test_eod_paper_archive.py tests/test_book_performance_report.py tests/test_source_inventory.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/daily_paper_cycle.py src/financial_brain/forward_edge/cli.py tests/test_daily_paper_cycle.py; python -m mypy src/financial_brain/forward_edge/daily_paper_cycle.py src/financial_brain/forward_edge/cli.py
test.result: 29 passed across daily-cycle, read-only preflight, evidence-bundle, EOD-archive, book-report, and source-inventory suites; Ruff and mypy passed. Integration finalized two synthetic accounts, verified both bundles and read the immutable report. Preflight validation left both account journal heads unchanged on success and on missing later-book evidence. No observed Kite-market result is claimed.

implemented: Portable bundles export account close archive and durable runner journal plus optional evidence inputs with SHA-256 and byte lengths.
Human-readable report derives exclusively from exported inputs and contains no profitability/live-execution overclaim.
Independent verifier checks archive hash, journal hash chain, manifest, input hashes, file set, optional Ed25519 signature, and deterministic report reproduction.
Cross-workstation copy test reproduces identical report bytes and validates with a pinned trusted public-key hash.
Tampering, undeclared files, symbolic links, mismatched trusted keys, and output reuse with another signing key are refused.

close_and_bundle_paper_session validates the runner journal hash chain, matching exchange date, and terminal session record before account close; then creates the account archive and portable bundle with immutable retry behavior.

Every portable bundle includes the paper-account journal; the verifier replays it, binds its exact sequence/head to the EOD archive, checks order and economic state, and reconciles NAV before report reproduction.

The forward-edge CLI exposes daily-finalize and daily-paper-cycle; the cycle discovers every account from a frozen plan, finalizes the close archive and bundle, and creates a deterministic by-book report from generated archives plus caller-supplied history.
The cycle is resumable per book and requires unchanged timestamps and marks on retry; account paths are derived from the registered plan.

The forward-edge CLI exposes the read-only daily-paper-preflight command, which validates all registered accounts, close marks, terminal strategy/account bindings and historical report rows before any book is finalized.
blockers: No OS scheduled job invokes the daily-paper-cycle command after each completed paper session.
Production signing-key custody and trusted public-key distribution are owner responsibilities and are not configured.
Bundle transfer has no managed delivery channel; this implementation exports a self-contained directory.
